personAnswers.3.2: Our platform holds customer data in UK and EU regions only, chosen by the customer at onboarding. No customer data is stored outside the chosen region.

edits.3.4: We follow the UK GDPR and the EU GDPR. Our Data Protection Officer reviews new processing activities, and we keep records of processing and data protection impact assessments for high-risk processing.
